query: Which method can be used for concurrent strength–ductility improvement, and why?

generation.hypothesis: Concurrent strength-ductility improvement can be achieved through grain refinement.
generation.intervention: Grain refinement through severe plastic deformation
generation.mechanism: Dislocation pile-up and grain boundary sliding
generation.baseline: Coarse-grained metal with low strength and ductility
generation.boundary: Limit of grain refinement, beyond which strength and ductility may decrease
generation.uncertainty: Effect of grain refinement on strength and ductility may vary depending on material and processing conditions

falsification_experiment.design: Compare mechanical properties of coarse-grained and fine-grained metals
falsification_experiment.falsification_rule: If fine-grained metal shows no improvement in strength and ductility compared to coarse-grained metal, the hypothesis is falsified.
